character_sheet: A tiny passive stink bug: a 6x5x8 body under a head with a jaw plate, two antennae, eight bumps on its back and two rocking nubs, a 4x4x6 tail block studded with twenty-two spots, and six 2x2 feet on six leg stubs (StinkBugModel.java:124-322, 50 parts), drawn at x0.85. 5 HP, speed 0.15, no attack (EntityStinkBug.java:57-62). It flees players within 4 blocks and panics when hurt (:50-51), breeds on a crystal apple (:49, :113-118) and, when it dies, releases a gas of nausea for fifteen seconds on everything within 8 blocks around and 10 above it, with a fart for a death sound (:75-78, :85-102). It spawns above y 50 (:120-126; ModEntities.java:449-451). Read it as a beetle: the feet twitching in a quick patter, the antennae waving, the spotted tail breathing.
size_notes: Drawn at x0.85 of the rig (StinkBugRenderer.java:21, :35; shadow 0.2975, :19) on a 64x32 sheet (StinkBugModel.java:324), stinkbug.png (StinkBugRenderer.java:14); the hitbox is 0.55 x 0.55 (ModEntities.java:449-451). The original's ModelStinkBug(0.75f) argument was the wingspeed (StinkBugModel.java:14), not a scale.

behaviour: One gait rhythm with no threshold (StinkBugModel.java:330-332): five of the six feet patter 54 degrees x the walking speed as a sine at 2.325 rad/tick (a 2.7-tick period), the right front and rear against the other three; the left middle foot is never written and stays still - a quirk of the model, not a design.

Four unscaled rhythms run at all times: the two back nubs rock 36 degrees in opposition on a 21-tick sine (:333-334), the jaw plate nods 7 degrees on a 42-tick sine (:335-336), the antennae wave 27 degrees on four sines of 17-21 ticks (:337-340), and the tail block with its twenty-two spots breathes 18 degrees on an 84-tick sine (:341-357).

The body, head, eight back bumps and six leg stubs are static; the head does not follow the look. The death gas (EntityStinkBug.java:85-102) is an effect on the kill, not a pose; there is no attack and no hurt sound (:70-73).
